This yields all-degree exact rational moments by cotree induction. The pairwise moment ratio R at a join has crossing value (N+1)/(N+2) and within-factor multiplier (a+2)/(a+1)*(N+1)/(N+2)>1, propagating edge R≤(n+1)/(n+2), nonedge R≥1 with strictness precisely for nonedges in connected components. Independently integrated the P4 stable-set polytope: normalization 5/24, E x2=7/25, E x2x3=1/15 and endpoint nonedge covariance -11/3750. The known forbidden induced P4 characterization then proves the hereditary iff; finite checks do not replace the Dirichlet proof.
